# laravelforge_site_domain_nginx (Data Source)

Fetches the per-domain nginx configuration block for a Laravel Forge site domain record.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_record_id` (Number) ID of the domain record whose nginx config this reads.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the domain record belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Current nginx configuration content as reported by Forge.
